body:
aiter removed `aiter.ops.triton.attention.mla_decode` in ROCm/aiter#6633. With current ATOM and aiter main, importing the Kimi MLA/GDN backend raises `ModuleNotFoundError` even when Triton MLA is disabled; the Triton decode path also depends on the deleted module.

Use the maintained `aiter.ops.triton.attention.mla.mla_decode_fwd` API for both plain and shuffled KV caches. View plain token rows as scheduler-sized pages and pass the existing block tables, context lengths, query offsets, and FP8 scales. Remove the obsolete CSR-to-dense conversion and decode scratch buffers from the Triton metadata builder.

Validation in `jun_atom2` with aiter main at `b3ad6c4617`:

- 77 tests passed across the new Triton MLA regression tests and existing attention-family, shuffled-KV, and MTP contract tests.
- GPU comparisons against an FP32 PyTorch reference cover plain/shuffled KV, block sizes 16/64, one-token/four-token decode, and BF16/FP8 inputs. FP8-query comparisons account for the kernel's FP8 probability rounding.
- CUDA graph replay matches eager execution exactly after updating context lengths and block tables.
- Black, Ruff, and `git diff --check` passed.

Full-model end-to-end inference has not been run.

### 🏷️ CI Guide

**Runs automatically on every eligible PR before approval:**
- ✅ Pre Checkin: Black, Ruff, catalog schema validation, non-GPU unit tests

**Heavy model tests:**
- ✅ Run after the PR is approved and Pre Checkin passes
- ✅ Run immediately when an approval review is submitted
- ✅ Can be requested before approval with labels

| Label | Tests |
|-------|-------|
| `ci:full` | Run all heavy PR model tests: native ATOM, vLLM, and SGLang |
| `ci:atom` | Run native ATOM model accuracy tests |
| `ci:vllm` | Run ATOM vLLM OOT model accuracy tests |
| `ci:sglang` | Run ATOM SGLang model accuracy tests |

> Heavy jobs are skipped when the PR is not approved and no matching `ci:*` label is present.
> Add labels via the sidebar or `gh pr edit 2669 --add-label <label>`
